title: Step 5 Preview Weights: Hardware, Access and License
key_facts: StepFun's Step 5 Preview is a mixture-of-experts model with 600 billion total and 27 billion active parameters, per its model card.
The official repositories were visible on 14 Oct 2026 (Vancouver), including an NVFP4 version of about 394 GB (95 shards); the main FP8 checkpoint is about 650 GB.
Kingy's anonymous checks found both repositories not gated (gated: false).
Weights come under StepFun Model License 1.0: use, copying, redistribution and modification allowed with notice and attribution duties.
Extra terms apply above 100 million active users or US$20 million revenue in a month (attribution), and commercial agreements for some hardware makers and large MaaS operators.
StepFun's examples use four B300 or eight H200 GPUs for FP8; a 128 GB machine cannot hold the NVFP4 files.
Kingy did not download the weights, run inference or test the model; the date the repositories opened is unverified.
quote_evidence: We did not download the complete weights, install a serving stack, run local inference or execute a matched coding comparison.
The exact time the repositories first opened to the public remains unverified.
This is a weight release with licensing limits.
why_it_matters_hint: Open weights for a 600-billion-parameter model exist, but running them needs data-centre-class hardware and the licence has conditions.
notes: Kingy's own repository check, not a hands-on test; nothing was run. Earlier report of a gated screen not reproduced.
